translation: If so, then Master Cheng's aim is to seek merit; but it is not so. Master Cheng fears that common men and women who are ill have no one to appeal to, and also fears that good physicians and good ministers are not complete in every generation; even if one cannot extinguish disease before it arises, one can still cure disease after it has arisen. Continuing the Song, he carved to give long life to the people, and thereby gave long life to the state; he has great deep intention. King Wen drew the hexagrams to make people know good and ill fortune, and Confucius wrote the 《Spring and Autumn Annals》 to make people know ruler and minister; this is the same intention.
